name: rigor-x
description: A deterministic control plane for structured multi-stage work, evidence tracking, verification, computation, and topic memory.

interface.longDescription: RIGOR-X is a deterministic control-plane engine for multi-stage work. Use it to structure complex tasks, preregister requirements, record evidence and host-performed actions, run deterministic verification gates, perform unit-aware calculations, and maintain per-user topic memory. Task and stage text are stored as hashes and lengths; source references, action receipts, calculation inputs and results, and saved topic-memory content are retained as described in the privacy policy. Google OAuth is required for the remote MCP connection. Verification is structural: it checks workflow order and completeness, not whether submitted claims are true. The host AI performs the work and must report only actions it actually completed.
defaultPrompt: Use RIGOR-X to plan and track this task through verification.
Research this question with RIGOR-X evidence records and source checks.
Check this calculation with RIGOR-X units and tolerances.
